integrity: The universal claim is proved structurally from proper-color-class and closed-neighborhood constraints. The embedded exhaustive checker independently enumerates finite profiles only as corroboration, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonempty matching deletions from complete bipartite graphs, excludes the balanced full-matching crown and the undeleted boundary, and treats only constant sequences \(S_q=(q^\infty)\) with \(q\ge2\).
title: Constant-sequence b-spectra of non-crown matching-deleted bicliques
